title: bugctl create: existing-path response is a stub, so idempotent consumers re-file work in flight

defect.observed: For a card that is really #58, queue in_progress, state in_fix, bugctl create --title <its exact title_key> --json returns existing:true but public_n 0, state new, queue ready - at the TOP LEVEL and again inside work_item. Measured 2026-10-14. So the one response an idempotent consumer uses to decide whether it has already claimed the work reports the opposite.
defect.expected: The existing path returns the cards real identity and state: public_n 58, the live state and queue, matching bugctl list and the detail read. An idempotent consumer must be able to tell claimed from unclaimed from create alone.
defect.criteria: On a card in state in_fix, create --title <that exact title_key> --json returns existing:true AND the same public_n, state and queue that bugctl list reports for it. Red-proof: today it returns public_n 0 and state new for that same card. Add a selftest asserting the existing-path response equals the list row for the same card.
